title: Figure 30: free-electron laser electron beam phase-space evolution
description: Diagram of an electron beam passing through an undulator between a resonator mirror pair, above three phase-space plots (gamma vs. z, 0 to lambda) showing the electron distribution progressively bunching into red/orange curves. Labelled "electron beam phase-space evolution" and captioned "Figure 30. Free-Electron Laser Electron Beam Phase-Space Evolution (courtesy of the Naval Post-Graduate School FEL Lab)." The following text explains electron bunching and lists benefits of FELs.
